newsitem.title: INDIA: Tecumseh buys India Siel unit --paper.
newsitem.headline: Tecumseh buys India Siel unit --paper.

text.p: U.S.-based refrigeration equipment maker Tecumseh Products Company (TPC) has bought the entire equity of Siel Compressors Ltd, a subsidiary of India's Siel Ltd, the Economic Times said on Monday.
Tecumseh had also completed the acquisition of the compressor manufacturing division of Whirlpool India Ltd, a unit of Whirpool Corp, the newspaper said.
Tecumseh announced last November its agreement to buy the Whirlpool unit in the northern Indian state of Haryana.

The newspaper quoted Tecumseh's chief executive officer, Todd Herrick, as saying that the two acquisitions would make Tecumseh the largest independent compressor manufacturer in the world and the largest compressor maker in India.

"With the twin acquisitions, Tecumseh will be controlling approximately 35 percent of the Indian market for compressors in room air-conditioners, commercial refrigeration equipment and domestic refrigerator segments in India," it quoted K.S. Madhavan, Tecumseh's head in India, as saying.
